inspiration: Ambience beds: twelve looped cabin-ambience clips sit under the event sounds, one bed chosen at a time (Sound/XRSound/assets/XRSound/Default/Cabin Ambience/). Idea: several looped beds per zone with variants, chosen by state. Fits the sound-music bed-per-zone topic.

Callouts by event group: the module maps sound IDs to clip folders (Sound/XRSound/assets/XRSound/XRSound.cfg:540-543). Idea: each fight event (guard, parry, break, finisher) maps to a callout group in data, so the sound is set by the table, not code.
Random-interval chatter: a bank of clips plays at random intervals (XRSound.cfg:546-550). Idea: idle barks at random intervals from a bank of our own generated lines, never real voices.

Staged mission chain: three chained mission scenarios plus a quickstart (Scenarios/Checklists/Mission 1 - DG to ISS.scn, Mission 2 - ISS to Mir.scn, Mission 3 - Deorbit.scn). Idea: a progression chain of start-state files, each one a playable stage, zones as data.
Swappable HUD panels defined by config: Config/MFD/ holds Attitude.cfg, Default.cfg and ScriptMFD.cfg. Idea: HUD panels as data with a default and a special panel, chosen per class or stance.

Optional hi-res texture tier: the base install ships without planet textures and a high-resolution set is added later (README.md:72-78). Idea: base art pack plus an optional hi-res pack at the same paths.
Per-body parameter tables with a notes file (GravityModels/, notes file not read). Idea: per-zone parameter tables documented in a notes file next to the data.

briefs.label: cabin hum bed
briefs.why: A looped low ambience bed that is always under the scene and changes variant with state gives a sense of place without music. Readable as a sound signature at fight volume: a low, steady, slightly varied hum.
keep: one bed chosen by state, not by time
a bed that sits under all event sounds
change: bed per zone (arena, shrine, pit), not a cabin
bed reacts to threat level, not flight state
our own sound design, no donor clips

briefs.label: idle bark bank
briefs.why: Short idle lines at random intervals keep a quiet arena alive without music. The random interval is what makes it feel alive; the bank size sets how often a line repeats.
keep: a bank of lines, not one clip
lines play only in idle time
change: lines are our own generated barks, never real voices
interval tied to the spawn timer
no speaker or station chatter style

briefs.label: staged mission chain
briefs.why: A short chain of start-state files, each a playable stage with its own start, makes progression feel like missions rather than levels. Shows how stage files can be data.
change: stages are our zones with spawn and loot changes
chain branches on a choice, not a straight line
briefs.ref: Scenarios/Checklists/Mission 1 - DG to ISS.scn, Mission 2 - ISS to Mir.scn, Mission 3 - Deorbit.scn

briefs.label: panel-per-stance HUD
briefs.why: Each HUD panel is a separate config file, so the player can swap a panel for a task (attitude, default) without new code. Useful for readability at 375 px with fewer panels per stance.
keep: a default panel and a task panel
change: panels per stance (guard, attack, rest) not per flight task
threat colour ramp of our own
